description: This file contains implementation of quantized batch normalization functions for CPU in PyTorch, including 1D, 2D, and 3D variants, with support for fused ReLU and integration with ONEDNN backend.

methods.name: compute_fused_params
methods.description: Computes alpha and beta parameters for batch normalization based on input statistics and scale factors.

methods.name: q_batch_norm1d_impl
methods.description: Implements 1D quantized batch normalization with optional fused ReLU.

methods.name: q_batch_norm2d_impl
methods.description: Implements 2D quantized batch normalization with optional fused ReLU.

methods.name: q_batch_norm3d_impl
methods.description: Implements 3D quantized batch normalization with optional fused ReLU.

methods.name: q_batch_norm_impl
methods.description: Dispatches to the appropriate batch normalization implementation based on input tensor dimension.

methods.name: int8_batch_norm2d_cpu_impl
methods.description: Performs quantized 2D batch normalization on CPU with int8 data, supporting specific output scale and zero point.

methods.name: quantized_batch_norm
methods.description: Public API for quantized batch normalization.
